sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: In the last few lectures I've been talking about the history of domestic building construction.
sentences.zh: 在最近几次讲座中，我一直在讲解住宅建筑施工的历史。

sentences.en: But today I want to begin looking at some contemporary, experimental designs for housing.
sentences.zh: 但今天，我想开始探讨一些当代的、实验性的住宅设计。

sentences.en: So, I'm going to start with a house which is constructed more or less under the ground.
sentences.zh: 因此，我将首先介绍一座基本建于地下的房屋。

sentences.en: And one of the interesting things about this project is that the owners - both professionals but not architects - wanted to be closely involved, so they decided to manage the project themselves.
sentences.zh: 这个项目一个有趣之处在于：房主双方都是专业人士，但并非建筑师，他们希望深度参与建造过程，因此决定自行管理整个项目。

sentences.en: air chief aim was to create somewhere that was as environmentally-friendly as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们的首要目标是打造一个尽可能环保的居所。

sentences.en: But at the same time they wanted to live somewhere peaceful - they'd both grown up in a rural area and disliked urban life.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他们也希望居住在一个宁静的地方——两人均在乡村长大，且不喜欢都市生活。

sentences.en: So the first thing they did was to look for a site.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们做的第一件事就是寻找合适的地块。

sentences.en: And they found a disused stone quarry in a beautiful area.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们在一处风景优美的地区发现了一座废弃的采石场。

sentences.en: The price was relatively low, and they liked the idea of recycling the land, as it were.
sentences.zh: 价格相对低廉，而且他们也很喜欢‘土地再利用’这一理念。

sentences.en: As it was, the quarry was an ugly blot on the landscape, and it wasn't productive any longer, either.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这座采石场已成为景观中一处刺眼的伤疤，且早已丧失了生产价值。

sentences.en: They consulted various architects and looked at a number of designs before finally deciding on one.
sentences.zh: 他们咨询了多位建筑师，并审阅了若干设计方案，最终选定其一。

sentences.en: As I've said, it was a design for a sort a of underground house, and it was it built into the earth itself, with two storeys.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前所说，该方案设计的是一种地下式住宅，整栋建筑嵌入大地之中，共两层。

sentences.en: The north, east and west sides were set in the earth, and only the sloping, south-facing side was exposed to light.
sentences.zh: 北、东、西三面均埋入地下，仅朝南的斜坡式立面暴露于阳光之下。

sentences.en: That was made of a double layer of very strong glass.
sentences.zh: 该立面采用双层高强度玻璃制成。

sentences.en: There were also photovoltaic tiles fixed to the top and bottom of this sloping wall.
sentences.zh: 此外，该斜坡墙体的顶部与底部还安装了光伏瓦片。

sentences.en: These are tiles that are designed to store energy from the sun.
sentences.zh: 这些瓦片专为储存太阳能而设计。

sentences.en: And the walls had a layer of foam around them too, to increase the insulation.
sentences.zh: 墙体外围还覆盖了一层泡沫材料，以增强隔热性能。

sentences.en: Now, what is of interest to us about this project S the features which make the building energy-efficient.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们关注该项目的重点在于使其具备高能效的各类特性。

sentences.en: Sunlight floods in through the glass wall, and to maximise it there are lots of mirrors and windows inside the house.
sentences.zh: 阳光透过玻璃墙体大量涌入室内；为最大限度利用自然光，屋内设置了大量镜子和窗户。

sentences.en: That helps to spread the light around.
sentences.zh: 这有助于将光线均匀散布至各处。

sentences.en: So that's the first thing - light is utilised as fully as possible.
sentences.zh: 因此，第一点便是：尽可能充分地利用自然光照。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Tapescripts In addition, the special tiles on the outside convert energy from the sun and generate 54 PA some of the house's electricity.
sentences.zh: 此外，外墙上的特殊瓦片可转化太阳能，为住宅部分供电。

sentences.en: In fact, and it's possible that in future the house may even generate an electricity surplus, and that the owners will be able to sell some to the national grid.
sentences.zh: 事实上，未来该住宅甚至可能产生电力盈余，届时业主便可将多余电力售予国家电网。

sentences.en: /e.com As well as that, wherever possible, recycled materials have been used.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，凡有可能之处，均使用了再生材料。

sentences.en: For example, the floors are made of reclaimed wood.
sentences.zh: 例如，地板采用回收木材制成。

sentences.en: And the owners haven't bought a single item of new furniture - they just kept what they already had.
sentences.zh: 而且，业主未购置任何一件新家具，仅沿用原有家具。

sentences.en: And then there's the system for dealing with the waste produced in the house.
sentences.zh: 再者，住宅产生的废弃物也有一套专门处理系统。

sentences.en: This is dealt with organically - it's purified by being filtered through reed beds which have been planted for that purpose in the garden.
sentences.zh: 该系统采用有机方式处理废弃物——通过花园中专为净化目的而栽种的芦苇床进行过滤净化。

sentences.en: So the occupants of the house won't pollute the land or use any damaging chemicals.
sentences.zh: 因此，住宅使用者既不会污染土地，也不会使用任何有害化学物质。

sentences.en: It's true that the actual construction of the house was harmful to the environment, mainly because they had to use massive amounts of concrete - one of the biggest sources of carbon dioxide in manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 诚然，房屋实际建造过程对环境造成了损害，主要原因在于大量使用混凝土——而混凝土制造正是二氧化碳的最大排放源之一。

sentences.en: And, as you know, this is very damaging to the environment.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，这对环境危害极大。

sentences.en: In total, the house construction has released 70 tons of carbon dioxide into the air.
sentences.zh: 总计而言，房屋建造过程向大气排放了70吨二氧化碳。

sentences.en: Now that's a frightening thought.
sentences.zh: 这的确是一个令人震惊的数字。

sentences.en: However, once the initial 'debt' has been cleared = and it's been calculated that this will only take fifteen years - this underground house won't cost anything - environmentally I mean because unlike ordinary houses, it is run in a way that is completely environmentally friendly.
sentences.zh: 然而，一旦初始‘环境债务’得以清偿——据测算，仅需十五年——这座地下住宅便不再产生任何环境成本（此处特指环境层面），因为与普通住宅不同，它完全以一种彻底环保的方式运行。

sentences.en: So, eco-housing like this is likely to become much more
sentences.zh: 因此，此类生态住宅未来很可能会变得愈发普及。
